entities.name: First Settlers and Temple Builders
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The arrival of Neolithic settlers from Sicily, the construction of the Ġgantija, Ħaġar Qim, Mnajdra, and Tarxien temples (the oldest freestanding structures on Earth), the Ħal Saflieni Hypogeum, and the mysterious collapse of the temple period.
